newsitem.title: CHINA: Goodyear opens $60 mln China tyre venture.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear opens $60 mln China tyre venture.

text.p: A $60.4 million tyre-making joint venture in northeast China, in which Goodyear Tire and Rubber Co of the United States has a majority stake, has started production, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Dalian Goodyear Tyre Co Ltd, in Dalian city in Liaoning province, has a daily production capacity of 3,000 tyres for sedans and light-duty trucks, Xinhua said.
The U.S. tyre giant holds a 75 percent stake in the venture while the Dalian Rubber Plant has the remaining 25 percent, the agency said.
Goodyear planned to invest $500 million in China by the year 2000, it said but gave no details.
The firm already had more than 1,000 service centres and nearly 60 sales agents across China, the agency said.
